responsibility: This generator reads target machine description (.md) attribute declarations and emits insn-attr-common.h, the small attribute interface shared between the driver and core compiler. Its job is to turn DEFINE_ATTR value lists into enum attr_* definitions and to summarize target scheduling features with preprocessor macros such as DELAY_SLOTS and INSN_SCHEDULING when DEFINE_DELAY or DEFINE_INSN_RESERVATION appear, providing a common, lightweight view of target attributes before the fuller insn-attr interfaces are generated.
